## BannerHub v6 1.6.0-604 > ## ⚠️ Important — please read before installing > > **BannerHub v6 does NOT replace BannerHub 3.7.x or BannerHub Lite — they are SEPARATE projects.** > > - **BannerHub** 3.7.x — built from the GameHub 5.3.5 ReVanced project by **PlayDay**. > - **BannerHub Lite** — built from GameHub Lite 5.1.4 by **Producdevity**. > - **BannerHub v6** *(this repo)* — built from XiaoJi GameHub 6.0.x on a brand-new pipeline. > > **None of the three are to be updated over by any of the others.** Each ships with its own package names, its own keystore, and its own component / Steam-client backend — Android won't accept an in-place update between them, and forcing one will leave you with a broken install. Uninstall first, then install the new project if you want to switch. > > Keep in mind **BannerHub v6 is still a work in progress** and will re-release frequently as new base GameHub versions come out from XiaoJi upstream. **Compatibility is different** — don't expect every game that works on BannerHub 3.7.x or Lite to work on v6, and vice versa. v6 uses a **new component system and new Steam clients** and, thus far, has been **barely tested in general**. > > **USE AT YOUR OWN RISK.** A patched build of **XiaoJi GameHub 6.0.4** that removes the login requirement (import and play games with no account) and redirects the catalog to the BannerHub Cloudflare Worker. Ships **9 variants that install side-by-side**, each with an optional **Lite** build (~34.5 MB / ≈32% smaller). **18 APKs attached** — 9 full + 9 Lite. Steam game launches work end-to-end. 🔒 **Privacy-hardened** — upstream telemetry/analytics channels stripped at the bytecode level. Full list of killed channels (and the honest leftovers) in [`PRIVACY.md`](https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-revanced/blob/gamehub-604-build/PRIVACY.md).
✨ Everything BannerHub v6 offers (click to expand) - **No login required** — launch straight to the home screen and import/play games without a XiaoJi account. - **Custom catalog API** — the catalog is redirected to the BannerHub Cloudflare Worker for **curated component delivery** (hand-picked DXVK, VKD3D-Proton, Box64, FEX, Mesa Turnip driver builds, etc.) instead of the stock upstream set. - **Privacy-hardened** — upstream telemetry/analytics channels stripped at the bytecode level (see the `PRIVACY.md` link above for the full list). - **PC-accurate controller vibration** — real XInput rumble routed into Android's VibratorManager with independent dual-motor support, configurable **per-game** (mode + intensity) via the **PC Vibration Settings** menu row. Preload-free — no `libevshim` / `LD_PRELOAD`. - **GOG integration** — sign in to GOG, browse your owned library, and download + install GOG games in-app; they're added to your GameHub library and launch like any other PC game. Reached from the Explore tab's GOG card or the Banner Tools → GOG tile. - **BannerHub Explore screen** — the bottom-nav "Explore" tab opens a BannerHub-owned, fully-offline screen (bundled content, routes to BannerHub destinations) instead of the stock online discovery feed. - **Recording-compatible audio** — optional toggle (Banner Tools → Audio) that routes PulseAudio through the mixer so screen recorders capture in-game sound. - **9 side-by-side variants** — different package names + launcher labels so multiple builds coexist on one device (`Original` replaces stock GameHub; the rest install alongside it). - **Optional Lite builds** — a ~34.5 MB-smaller counterpart of every variant. - **Muted UI sounds** — menu/button click sounds silenced; in-game audio untouched. - **Root-free file manager access** — a content provider lets MT Manager and similar apps browse GameHub's data dir without root. - **Portrait PC-settings** — per-game PC settings render in both landscape and portrait (side benefit of the API redirect). - **Installs in place** — stable signing keystore; future BannerHub v6 stables upgrade without uninstalling. - **BannerHub v6 branding** — custom app icon, Wine container header, and auth/splash artwork. - **Triage-friendly** — debuggable build with logcat markers along the import path.
### What's new in 1.6.0-604 On top of `v1.5.1-604` (same keystore — installs in place): ### 🎮 GOG integration Sign in, browse your owned library, and download + install GOG games straight from BannerHub, no extra apps. Reach it from the new **Explore** tab's GOG card or the **Banner Tools → GOG** tile: log in with your GOG account, pick from your owned games, download + install, and the game is added to your GameHub library and launches like any other PC game. *Note: a freshly added GOG game shows up in your library after a GameHub restart.* ### 🧭 BannerHub Explore screen The bottom-nav "Explore" tab now opens a BannerHub-owned, fully-offline screen instead of the stock online discovery feed. v1 surfaces a **GOG** card (with logo) that opens the GOG hub; content is bundled in the APK, so it works with no network and routes to BannerHub's own destinations. ### 🎙️ Recording-compatible audio toggle **Banner Tools → Audio** — fixes **silent screen recordings**. PulseAudio's AAudio MMAP fast-path bypassed the system mixer that screen recorders tap, so captures had no game audio; the toggle routes audio through the mixer (`pm=0`) so MediaProjection picks up in-game sound. Global setting, off by default. ### Variants Each variant has its own package name + launcher label, so the variants install **side-by-side** with each other. `Original` replaces an installed GameHub; the rest install alongside it. **Full vs Lite:** a Lite APK shares its full counterpart's package name and cert — installing Lite **replaces** the matching full build (and vice versa). Thrilled to announce the initial public release of **Pixel Camera v1.0.0**! 

This release backports next-generation Google Pixel 11 camera features—including **Camera Looks**, **Viewfinder Quick Access Controls**, **5x Optical Telephoto Portrait**, and the **Creator Suite**—to older Tensor devices (**Pixel 6 through Pixel 10**), completely usable **without root**!

---

## What's New in v1.0.0

### 1. Ten Signature "Camera Looks" (Sauce & Tomte)
* **Real-time Viewfinder Rendering**: Live preview and hardware-accelerated processing of all 10 color and tone styles.
* **Full Preset Spectrum**:
  * **Original** — Classic true-to-life Google HDR+.
  * **Natural** — Subtle softening with neutral, true skin tones.
  * **Shadows** — Punchy, moody contrast and deep blacks.
  * **Vanilla** — Warm, golden-hour radiance with soft ambient glow.
  * **Editorial** — Kodachrome-inspired magazine colors and rich contrast.
  * **Velvet** — Saturated landscape tones reminiscent of Fuji Velvia.
  * **Classic** — Timeless analog film aesthetic inspired by Kodak Portra.
  * **Digi** — Early-2000s compact digital camera punch and flare.
  * **Black Tie** — Fine-grain, high-contrast monochrome dynamic range.
  * **Minimal** — Clean, desaturated Scandinavian aesthetic.
* **Universal Tensor Engine**: Automatic fallback execution on Mali-G715 / Immortalis GPU and multi-threaded Halide CPU workers on Tensor G1–G4 devices without vendor HAL dependencies.

### 2. Viewfinder Quick Access Controls & Discrete Tick-Slider
* **Custom Viewfinder Shortcuts**: Assign Left and Right quick shortcuts directly in Camera Settings (`Settings → Fast access → Quick access controls`).
* **On-Screen Tick Slider**: Tap anywhere on the viewfinder to reveal the vertical 10-tick slider—scrub through all Looks seamlessly without diving into menus.
* **Haptic Feedback**: Tactile feedback on slider detents with persistent preference memory across app restarts.

### 3. 5x Optical Telephoto Portrait Mode & 10x Quick Zoom
* **True 5x Optical Telephoto Bokeh**: Unlocks physical periscope portrait captures (`RAW_TELE` + `PD_TELE`) on Pixel 7 Pro, 8 Pro, 9 Pro, and 10 Pro—breaking the 1.5x / 2.0x digital crop restriction.
* **Dedicated 10x Quick Zoom Viewfinder Button**: Instant 1-tap Super Res Zoom toggle on the viewfinder (`0.5x, 1x, 2x, 5x, 10x`) powered by Google's `NativeZoomPlus` and `NativeFusionZoom` pipelines.

### 4. Pixel Camera Creator Suite
* **Teleprompter HUD (`biotite`)**: Viewfinder script overlay with auto-scrolling, customizable WPM speed, and inline script editing.
* **Live Audio VU Meter (`mica`)**: Real-time microphone input volume indicator rendered over the viewfinder.
* **Social Framing Guides (`slate`)**: Quick grid overlays for 9:16 vertical video, 1:1 square, and standard ratios.

### 5. Dual Installation (Standalone Clone APK)
* Renamed package namespace to `com.google.android.GoogleCameraEng` allowing side-by-side installation with your stock Google Camera app.
* No root, Magisk, or Bootloader unlocking required.

---

## Hardware Compatibility Matrix

| Device Generation | SoC | Looks | Quick Access | 5x Portrait | 10x Zoom | Processing Mode |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **Pixel 11** | Tensor G6 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | Native TPU + HAL |
| **Pixel 10 / 10 Pro** | Tensor G5 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ (Pro) | ✅ (Pro) | Hybrid TPU / GPU |
| **Pixel 9 / 9 Pro / 9 Pro XL** | Tensor G4 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ (Pro) | ✅ (Pro) | GPU / TPU Fallback |
| **Pixel 8 / 8 Pro / 8a** | Tensor G3 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ (Pro) | ✅ (Pro) | Mali-G715 GPU |
| **Pixel 7 / 7 Pro / 7a** | Tensor G2 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ (Pro) | ✅ (Pro) | GPU / Halide CPU |
| **Pixel 6 / 6 Pro / 6a** | Tensor G1 | ✅ | ✅ | 4x opt (Pro) | ✅ (Pro) | Halide CPU Worker |

This release gathers everything since v0.8.0 and brings 86 patches for Facebook 582.0.0.50.54, up from 85. The new one is `Share sheet items`, which takes the items you pick off Facebook's share sheet. Morphe Manager's default selection now holds every patch but three, and after an update the settings page tells you which switches start off now. New switches hide the share sheet's Send to group buttons, share a post's own link instead of a /share/ link, play reels once and hide the Follow link on posts. Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer is required.

New in this release

- `Comment sheet options` has a fourth switch under Comments, `Hide related groups`. It takes the Related groups list and its Join buttons out from under a group post's comments, and the comments themselves stay. It starts off, and the diagnostic report counts each list it keeps out.

- `Share sheet items` is a new patch. It lets you hide items from Facebook's share sheet, such as WhatsApp, Meta AI or Copy link. Nothing is hidden until you tap `Share sheet items to hide` under Links and tick what you don't want. The list starts with the items Facebook has offered on your phone and then common ones. The rest keep Facebook's order, and pausing Hushfacebook brings everything back. It shares one hook with the Threads switch in `Hide Meta upsells`, so both can be in the same build. The idea comes from icysymmetra's TikTok patches.

- After an update, the settings page names the switches that now start off, so you can turn back on the ones you used.

- Export settings now carries your Share sheet items picks, including item types this version doesn't name, and the import preview says how many it will hide.

- The settings home page ends with Support Hushfacebook, which opens the Ko-fi page in your browser.

- Privacy now ends with a map of where ads and tracking are blocked. Each line takes you to its switch, says it was set when you patched, or names the patch to add, and the blocks that cost something say what they cost.

- `Share sheet items` has a new switch under Links, `Hide group buttons in the share sheet`, off to start. It takes away Send to group when you pick two or more people, and the share sheet's own ways to start a new group, so nothing you share turns into a group chat by accident. Send separately stays (#104).

- `Sanitize sharing links` has a new switch under Links, `Share the post's own link`, off to start. Copy link and the share sheet's other link shares give the post's own facebook.com address instead of a facebook.com/share/ link made for that one share (#98).

- `Clean up Reels` has a new switch under Reels, `Play reels once`, off to start. A reel stops on its last frame instead of starting over. Tap it to watch again, or swipe on. Feed videos and stories don't change.

- `Hide post prompts` has a new switch under Feed, `Hide the Follow link on posts`, off to start. It takes the "Follow" link off the name on posts from Pages and people you don't follow, so it can't be tapped by accident. Tapping the name still opens the profile (#107).

Fixes

- `Open on a chosen tab` set to Feeds opens the Feeds page over Home when your tab bar has no Feeds tab, on the filter `Feeds opens on` picks. Back goes to Home.

- `Open links in external browser` sends out links written in capitals, like a Page post's HTTPS://SHOP.EXAMPLE. Android reads the start of a link letter for letter, so your browser didn't recognize it, and the link opened in Facebook's own browser with a "No external browser took the link" message. Links that an app on your phone claims, a video site's for example, now reach that app even when they're written in capitals.

- `Offer to download copied links` saves reels and videos from copied share links again, the facebook.com/share/r/ and /share/v/ kind that Facebook's Copy link gives you. Facebook answered Android's own way of asking with a page instead of the video's address, so every share link said "Couldn't find the video in that link" and opened in Facebook.

Other changes

- Picking a comment order or a playback quality now turns its switch on, so the pick takes effect right away.

- Morphe Manager's default selection now holds every patch but three, so you don't need Expert mode to get `Hide the Reels tab`, `Tap to play`, `Download any video` and the rest. The 32 patches that joined it start with their switches off, and a fresh patch looks like the Facebook you know until you turn things on in Hushfacebook settings. `AMOLED black theme` and `Material You theme` stay out because their colors go in when you patch and there's no switch to take them back out. `Disable Play Store updates` stays out because it raises the version number Android sees, so a later build without it can't install over yours, and it doesn't work on a root mount. Turn on Expert mode to pick those three.

- If you'd picked one of those patches before and never changed its switch, the switch starts off after you update. Hushfacebook keeps no record of the build you came from, so it can't tell you meant it on. Look these over in Hushfacebook settings and turn back on the ones you want: Hide Reels in the feed, Keep feed position on return, Hide the Stories tray, Hide Stories between posts, Stop Story auto-advance, View stories anonymously, Hide prompts and promos under reels, Hide the Follow button on reels, Hide comment and reaction previews, Don't send reel watch history, Turn off double tap to like, Hold a reel for 2x, Default comment order, Tag suggestions only after @, Tap to play, Default playback quality, Picture-in-picture, Turn off HDR brightness, Use the system font, Use the phone's emoji, Turn off haptics, Turn off screen transitions, Download feed and Watch videos, Hide the Reels tab, Hold back analytics uploads, Allow screenshots, Block screenshot detection, Hide typing in chats, Hide typing in comments and Hide read receipts. A switch you'd already turned off, or a list you'd filled in, stays as you left it.

- Expert mode's patch list comes in smaller groups. Interface held 42 patches, so it's split into Theme, Navigation, Playback, Reels, Stories, Comments and Chats, and no group has more than a dozen now.

- Every patch description in Morphe Manager is rewritten in plain English for people patching for the first time. Each one says what changes and why you might want it, then ends the same way, with how its switch starts and where to find it, like "Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch." Patches with no switch say they work as soon as you patch them in.

- The text in Hushfacebook settings is rewritten in plain English. Each row now says what it does and why you'd turn it on, and the rows that need a restart say "Restart Facebook to see the change." The German, Spanish, Indonesian, Brazilian Portuguese and Turkish text is updated to match.

- Messages from Hushfacebook are plainer too. Failed downloads, settings import and export, update checks, font files and link settings now say what went wrong and what to try next, without terms like "package name" or "kana". The translations are updated to match.

- The Background color option on `AMOLED black theme` explains itself better. It asks for a six-digit color code like #0D1117, and the message shown for a color it can't use says the same.

- The `AMOLED black theme` option is now called Background color, and when it refuses a color, the message says what to type instead.

- `Allow screenshots` also clears a secure mark a page already had, from before you turned the switch on or from a path the patch doesn't reach, the next time Facebook changes anything about that page's window. Before, that page stayed black in screenshots until you opened it again. The idea comes from icysymmetra's TikTok patches.

- `Restore screens on re-signed builds` says photos and posts need it too, in its description and in the warning settings show when a re-signed build doesn't have it. Leaving it out stops photos and posts from opening, not only profiles, so the old wording made it look safe to skip.

Removed

- Hushfacebook now targets Facebook 582.0.0.50.54 only, the newest stable release, in its arm64-v8a and 32-bit builds. If you're still on 581.0.0.45.58, 580.0.0.51.74 or 577.0.0.50.72, update Facebook to 582 before you patch. From here on each release moves to the newest stable Facebook and drops the one before.

Behind the scenes

- The contributor guide maps patch sources, runtime extensions, and the patch workflow. The Facebook 581 audit traces ad delivery and tracking controls, records the signed-in stock screens, and measures foreground, background and screen-off activity. It includes network metadata, two settings screenshots and code search targets for browser history, camera-roll processing and the Facebook Plus icon screen in #109. It separates observed behavior from paths that still need a device check.

- `scripts/phone-smoke.ps1` walks a patched Facebook on a phone through the feed, Watch, Reels, notifications and Marketplace, saves a full diagnostic report from Hushfacebook settings and pulls it. It fails when a hook family reports anything missing, ambiguous or thrown, when a family you name with `-ExpectInvoked` never ran, or when Facebook crashed during the walk. A crash the report kept from before the walk doesn't count. `scripts/test-phone-smoke.ps1` checks the report reading without a phone.

- Settings tests now match the current patch list, switch defaults and supported-link explanation. Story privacy tests clear shared diagnostic counters before each case so an earlier test can't change their results.

- The desktop CLI runs, bundle merges and the resource, register and fingerprint checks now wait for a slot of the machine's build queue when `BUILD_QUEUE_SCRIPT` names one, and run straight away when it doesn't. Before, they started beside whatever builds were running and the queue never saw them.

- The patch tests that read the Facebook fixtures run as their own Gradle task, `:patches:fixtureTest`, with each fixture's path and SHA-256 as its inputs. A change to the fixtures reruns only those tests, and a fixture swapped for another of the same size and date still counts as a change. Each fixture's dex is now read and parsed once per test run rather than once per lookup. `:patches:test` still runs every test, and refuses a run where a fixture test skipped with the fixture folder set.

- The pre-push gate runs Gradle twice. Everything but the fixture tests goes first, so a failing quick test or lint stops the push in minutes, and the full run with the fixture tests comes second. `scripts/release/release.ps1 -Stage preflight` runs the quick checks a release needs in about five minutes: the script contracts, that same quick patch run, the translation and release-check tests, both lints and the release facts.

- `tools/release_text.py` writes a release's text. `cut` turns Unreleased into the dated section with a Facebook summary first, `bump` moves the version and the README badge, `check-translations` holds every table to the same strings and `L10nTranslations.java` to the tables, `github-notes` writes the notes with every bullet kept and checks that the app's update check reads the newest declared build from them, and `index` writes `patches-bundle.json`, the README's latest-release sentence and the bug form. Its tests run with `py -3.13 -I -m unittest discover -s tools -p "test_*.py"`.

- A release patches each Facebook fixture once instead of twice. The pre-push gate now patches the fixtures with the release bundle from `build/release` when the patch sources or the version change, and keeps each passing run with a stamp naming the bundle, APK, patch list and CLI. `build-release-receipt.ps1 -AppliedDir` reads a kept run whose stamp matches and runs every check on it, and patches any other fixture as before.

- `scripts/release/release.ps1` runs the whole release in five stages, each refusing to start until the one before it is done. `source` cuts the CHANGELOG, bumps the version, writes the patch list and checks the translations, and puts the tree back if a step fails. `preflight` adds the release text tests, the translation check and a draft of the GitHub notes to its quick checks. `bundle` builds from the pushed source commit and writes the receipt from the gate's kept runs plus `SHA256SUMS.txt`. `publish` tags, creates the release and downloads every asset back to compare it. `index` writes `patches-bundle.json`, the README and the bug form from the published release and the gate's test counts, then updates the repository description. The pre-push gate now runs the release text tests and the script contract tests when only `tools/` changes, and the phone smoke report checks when `phone-smoke.ps1` changes.

- The marketing script no longer writes `assets/readme-hero.png`, which has been separate artwork since the quieter hero. The social preview it still builds says "Safe mode built in" in place of "Recovery built in", which people read as a promise about Messenger's chat backup PIN.

- Every patch finds its places in Facebook 582. That build moves more text into lookup lists, reads its config flags through new helpers or straight from the config, and folds some classes into their parents or into one shared object, so the patches and their fixture checks now accept each of those forms.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 1.34.0 or newer, then refresh the Hushfacebook source.
2. Patch Facebook `582.0.0.50.54`. On most phones that's build `475417104`, the arm64-v8a one. Phones with a 32-bit processor take build `475417036`, the armeabi-v7a one.
3. Install over your current patched Facebook with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook#install).

Look over a diagnostic report before you share it. The filter can still miss private text it doesn't recognize.

What was checked

Local checks passed: 2331 runtime tests and 842 patch tests with no failures, plus both Android lints and the release-script checks. All 86 patches applied without forcing to both Facebook 582.0.0.50.54 builds (arm64-v8a and 32-bit), and the only manifest changes are the four permission renames that let it install beside Meta's apps. I also patched 582 with every patch on an arm64 phone. Facebook opened signed in with no crash, and a walk through the feed, Watch, Reels, notifications and Marketplace ran 53 of the 55 hook families with none missing its target. The Hushfacebook row sat at the end of Settings and privacy and opened the settings, and reels showed the Download button.

25cc97a2abfa8b413121e9dd: JioHotstar account-flag fix. The re-signed build was sending IsTampered=true in the device-attestation blob (Kg/b) it posts to the server, which locked the account 24h for "suspicious activity" (error NM-4290). Adds "Spoof device attestation": forces all 8 attestation security flags (IsEmulator/IsRooted/IsTampered/IsProxy/isVpnActive/isSuspiciousFileExists/isPortsOpen/isDebuggerEnabled) to false at the blob constructor, so the app reports a clean device. WARNING: this only removes a client-sent signal — the server still sees the VPN exit IP and an already-flagged account stays on Hotstars radar. Do NOT run on an account you cannot afford to lose; test on a throwaway Jio number first. Other apps unchanged.

Hushfeed v0.15.0 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`).

This is the first release under the project's own name. The bundle, the entry in TikTok's settings and the settings screen say Hushfeed, and the about row links to the project page.

Since v0.14.0:

* The block button targets the video on screen instead of the one prefetched next. The same fix reaches Not interested, the follow and like confirmations, double tap to open comments and the sound button.
* The creator's country can sit beside their name, and classified videos can play without the warning overlay.
* The caption, music line, action column, survey cards and status bar each have a switch under Hide video overlays.
* A long press on a video can keep TikTok's action, do nothing, or open the comments.
* The settings screen follows the phone's language. English and German ship; a translation table and a generator make the next language a single file.
* Settings backups carry the hushfeed-settings tag. Older backups and undo copies still restore.

Install: download `patches-0.15.0.mpp`, load it in Morphe Manager as a local bundle, patch TikTok 46.2.3 and keep the manager's signing key.

Validation: 149 runtime tests passed, the bundle holds 61 patches and passed the checks for all three DEX payloads, and every patch with a new fingerprint was applied to the real 46.2.3 APK with the desktop CLI. Behaviour that needs a person on the phone is listed in the project's blocked roadmap.

- `Change ChMate package name` を初期状態で有効にしました。パッケージ名に加え、アプリ名、PNG/WebPアイコン、versionCodeを変更できます。
- パッケージ名変更後でも、ChMateバックアップに残る旧パッケージ参照を現在のパッケージへ補正するようにしました。
- Shizukuを利用し、旧ChMateの共有データを別パッケージ版へコピーする補助機能を追加しました。
- 広告を非表示にしている場合、広告SDKと関連する計測SDKの初期化も抑制するようにしました。
- 任意パッチ `Save ChMate crash logs` を追加しました。有効にすると、未処理例外のログを `Download/Haiagaru/` に保存します。投稿本文やCookieは記録しません。
- 対応対象から ChMate `0.8.10.242 dev` を削除しました。

## 注意事項

- これはプレリリースです。適用前にChMate本来のバックアップ／復元機能でバックアップすることを推奨します。
- パッケージ名変更により予期せぬエラーが発生する可能性がありますが、既存のChMateとは別アプリとして扱われるため、インストール時の競合エラーを抑えられます。
- 元のパッケージ名を維持したい場合は、Morpheで `Change ChMate package name` を無効にしてください。
- `Change ChMate package name` を有効にしたAPKは、新Shizuku APIの要件によりAndroid 7.0（API 24）以降が必要です。
- クラッシュログ保存は初期状態で無効です。必要な場合のみ `Save ChMate crash logs` を有効にしてください。

HushTelegram v0.0.4 is the first release. It has 4 patches for telegram.org's Telegram 12.10.6 (`org.telegram.messenger.web`), and every one of them is selected by default.

## What's in it

- **Hide ads** stops Telegram asking for sponsored messages in channels, the sponsored accounts it pins above search results and the ads in its video player. Nothing is fetched, so nothing is shown or counted as seen.
- **Disable analytics** keeps two reports on your phone. One is the device statistics report, which lists your storage folders. The other says how long each channel post stayed on your screen. View counts still work.
- **Disable update checks** turns off telegram.org's own update offer. Those updates are signed with Telegram's key and can't install over a patched build, so you update through Morphe Manager instead.
- **HushTelegram settings** opens from a long-press on the Telegram icon, or from Additional settings in the app on Telegram's App info page. Each feature has its own switch, and you can pause everything, back up your switches and export a diagnostic report.

## Install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 1.32.0 or newer.
2. Add HushTelegram as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushTelegram
3. Download Telegram **12.10.6** from [telegram.org](https://telegram.org/android), version code **71129**, and patch it.
4. Uninstall the stock Telegram before you install the patched one, since Android won't put one over the other. Your chats come back when you sign in again, but secret chats don't. Back up Morphe Manager's signing key after your first patch. You'll need it for every update.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram#install).

## Known limitations

- Push notifications don't arrive. Google's Firebase only delivers them to an app signed with Telegram's own key. Telegram's Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection (Settings, then Notifications and Sounds) keep its own connection open instead, at some cost in battery, though that hasn't been tried on a patched build yet. Getting Firebase to accept a patched Telegram is the next thing being worked on.
- The map in the location picker stays blank for the same reason. Google's Maps key only answers Telegram's own signature.
- Only telegram.org's Telegram is supported. The Play Store one (`org.telegram.messenger`) comes once it has a checked build of its own.
- Hide ads was seen taking a live search ad off the screen. The test account wasn't shown a channel or video ad, so those two haven't been seen on a real one yet. If an ad gets through, please open an issue with a diagnostic report.

## Validation

336 runtime tests and 100 patch tests passed locally, along with both Android lints and the release script checks. All 4 patches applied without forcing to Telegram 12.10.6, and the only change to the app's manifest is the settings entry on App info. The dependency advisory check passed. The same patch code ran on a signed-in Android 16 phone. A search that showed an ad with Hide ads off showed none with it on, and the diagnostic report counted the skipped search ad, read-time and update requests.

Hushfacebook v0.4.0 gathers the fixes and additions since v0.3.4. It targets Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and still supports 577.0.0.50.72, with the same 43 patches.

## What's new

- **Clone app copies.** A copy of Facebook renamed with Morphe's Clone app patch recognises itself again, so Dark mode and Active status should open there (#16).
- **AMOLED black theme.** The status bar stays black when you come back to Facebook from Recent Apps, on the Reels and Video tabs too (#22).
- **Keep your feed.** Block background-return feed refresh has a new No time limit switch, so your place stays however long you're away (#23).
- **Saves.** Running saves are listed under Downloads with a Cancel button, which helps when notifications are off. A save cut short is cleaned up the next time Facebook starts. Error pages, oversized manifests and a full phone now stop a save sooner, and Cancel stops a video while its picture and sound are being joined.
- **Diagnostic reports.** Export diagnostic report always gives a report with your build details, even when nothing was logged. It leaves out more credentials and IDs, says what a saved video actually holds, and counts why a reel has no Download button (#18).
- **Feed filter.** Closes a way Facebook could swap sponsored posts into the news feed past the filter.
- **Settings.** A Supported links row shows whether Android opens facebook.com links in this app, with a shortcut to Android's page for it. Reels and Watch opens with a map of which switch hides which Reels surface. Search tells TalkBack how many settings it found, category pages say when Hushfacebook is paused, and settings import and export now report what was really saved.

## Update

1. Refresh the Hushfacebook source in Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer.
2. Patch the arm64-v8a, Android 11+ bundle of Facebook **580.0.0.51.74**, build **475019344**. Facebook **577.0.0.50.72**, build **474426275**, is also supported.
3. Install over your current patched Facebook using the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key to preserve update compatibility.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook#install).

## Known limitations

Most of this release was checked with automated tests and hasn't been tried on a phone yet, in particular the clone fix, the AMOLED status bar, the running saves list and the feed swap check. Sign-in, notifications and links in a Clone app copy haven't been checked at all. Some reports still need the affected phone or viewer: WhatsApp import (#11), Media settings (#12), Xiaomi Gallery audio (#14) and the missing Reel Download button (#18), where a diagnostic report now shows which reel sidebar Facebook drew.

Review diagnostic reports before sharing them. The filter can still miss private text it doesn't recognise.

## Validation

Local checks passed: 1094 runtime tests and 473 patch tests with no failures or skips, plus both Android lints and the release-script checks. All 43 patches applied without forcing to both supported Facebook builds, with no resource or injected-code structural errors. The dependency advisory check passed.

## Settings

* Hushfeed settings now opens with a live status card that shows the installed Hushfeed and TikTok versions. Diagnostics is one tap away.
* Feed filter, Privacy and Screen time now have direct buttons under Search.
* The new controls expose native button roles, visible focus and press feedback, and touch targets of at least 48 dp.
* The overview stacks cleanly when Android text is enlarged.

## Compatibility

Hushfeed v0.47.0 targets TikTok 47.0.3. All 91 patches applied to the retained 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3, 46.9.3 and 47.0.3 fixtures with no manifest changes. The full build was installed over the existing signed-in TikTok app on the S22 test phone with the same signing key, and the new overview and all four routes were exercised there.

Use the TikTok 47.0.3 universal APK. Keep your existing Morphe signing key when updating so Android can preserve TikTok's app data.

HushMessenger v0.8.0 is for Messenger 580.0.0.49.91 and works on all 21 arm64 builds. It has the same 31 patches as v0.7.0, and 28 of them are switches you turn on in settings.

The fix a lot of you were waiting for is in here. Patching with **Material You theme** selected no longer runs Morphe Manager out of memory (#18). Thanks to everyone who reported it and posted what they saw.

**New patches**

None this time. The App tab does get one new feature:

- **Save choices to a file** and **Restore choices from a file** go through Android's file picker, so HushMessenger doesn't need storage access. The file uses the same format as the clipboard backup. If you cancel, or pick a file that's damaged or isn't a backup, nothing changes.

**Fixes and changes**

- **Material You theme** checks every spot it changes before it edits anything. That keeps a full patch run within a 1 GB heap, the limit people ran into in #18, on every supported build.
- Safe mode has a **Resume** button now. If you'd already turned on **Pause all changes**, the button reads **Clear safe mode** and leaves Pause alone. Your saved choices stay either way.
- Crash recovery reads Android's own record of why Messenger stopped. When Android closes Messenger for low memory or an app update, that no longer counts toward safe mode, and the same crash can't be counted twice.
- **Open** in settings takes you to Messenger instead of back into settings.
- The status line under each switch refreshes when you come back to settings. Paused switches say **Changes paused**, and the text is easier to read in both themes.
- **Keep unsent messages** now explains right beside the switch what it covers (#23). It works on Messenger's older unsend path. End-to-end encrypted chats aren't covered, and group chats haven't been checked. Its activity line only moves when it really catches an unsend, and two unsends arriving together can't overwrite each other anymore.
- When **Hide app drawer icon** isn't offered, the App tab says why, for example on a Root Mount install. Searching settings for "drawer icon" takes you there (#6).
- The update check shows that it's working and has a **Check now** button if it fails. Turning it off or closing settings stops a check that's still running. It only trusts a small, well formed reply that points at this repository.
- Restoring a backup checks the whole thing first, so one bad line means nothing changes instead of half a restore. Older clipboard backups still work. Switches a backup doesn't mention keep their current setting.
- Tapping a backup button twice quickly no longer opens two pickers.
- The Menu tab's HushMessenger row checks every place it edits before it changes any of them.

**Updating**

1. Use Morphe Manager 1.33.0 or newer, since that's the version the memory fix was tried with, and refresh the HushMessenger source. It should show v0.8.0 with 31 patches. On a computer, Morphe Desktop needs 1.17.0 or newer.
2. Patch an unmodified arm64 Messenger **580.0.0.49.91**. Any of the 21 version codes listed under Supported Messenger builds in the README works, for example 346013440 or 346013387. The 32-bit builds aren't supported.
3. Sign with the same key you used last time and install over your current copy. A different key means uninstalling Messenger and losing its local data.
4. Open HushMessenger settings and tap **Restart Messenger**.

The `.mpp` file is a patch bundle for Morphe. It isn't an APK you can install.

**Known limitations**

- Saving and restoring choices with a file has only been covered by the automated tests. It hasn't been tried on a phone yet.
- The Android 17 crash records are covered by tests, but no phone running Android 17 has tried this build.
- Morphe Manager was tried at its 1 GB limit with build 346013440 while this was being built. The release bundle itself was checked at that limit with Morphe Desktop on all 21 builds.
- Keep unsent messages doesn't work in end-to-end encrypted chats, and group chats haven't been checked.
- After you view a story anonymously, the ring around that person's picture in your chat list still shows the story as new until it expires.
- Nobody has checked a fresh sign-in or recovering encrypted chat history on a phone yet, and live ad removal is still unconfirmed. Builds 346013354, 346013370, 346013394 and 346013423 patch cleanly but haven't been installed on a phone.

**Validation**

- 121 Kotlin tests, 352 Android unit tests and 47 Python checks pass. Android lint reports no errors.
- Morphe Desktop 1.18.0 applied all 31 patches, Material You included, to every one of the 21 supported builds with a 1024 MB Java heap and without forcing compatibility. Each output had the settings code and the expected number of theme edits, and the stock files were unchanged afterwards.
- One build from each of the five groups that share internal names (346013440, 346013372, 346013423, 346013357 and 346013374) was also patched and signed, and apksigner verified every v3 signature.
- Two clean builds of the bundle, one of them from a fresh checkout of the release commit, came out byte for byte the same.
- OSV-Scanner found no known advisories in anything the bundle ships or the patch build runs. Its only hits are old Netty and Apache HTTP libraries that the Android Gradle plugin keeps for its device test runner, which this build doesn't use.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt.sig` is signed with the release key `SHA256:Z+UfHy7IUbtgNRO/wHkIr68+u4I+SIKPY9avfx/VAPU`. The README shows how to check it with `ssh-keygen`.

The full list is in the [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/blob/v0.8.0/CHANGELOG.md).
